qt: to the Commission Galato Alexandraki (ECR) Subject:

On 2 August 2026, two leased Bell 214ST helicopters collided in Psatha leaving two crew members dead and two injured. On 25 June 2026, a leased Bell 214B helicopter had crashed into Lake Aoos. In 2026, Greece announced that it had 51 leased aircraft and a national fleet of just 33 aircraft. The NSPA recorded 49 wet leases for Greece for the period 2024-2028 and McDermott committed 15 Bell helicopters for Greece for the seventh consecutive year The Hellenic Fire Service has three BK-117 helicopters and two Super Pumas, the latter of which have now been equipped with water tanks. Aerial firefighting is excluded from the EASA regulatory framework by Article 2(3)(a) of Decision (EU) 2018/1139. The purchase of eight H215 helicopters costs EUR 311.2 million (EUR 77.8 million of which is provided by the Recovery and Resilience Facility and EUR 233.4 million by the European Regional Development Fund), with the first two helicopters announced for summer 2026. The cost of the aircraft leased since 2019 is close to EUR 500 million and new contracts over the next five years amount to a total of nearly EUR 400 million. The aircraft are leased through the NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA), which applies its own procurement rules and is not bound by European public procurement law. That means hundreds of millions of euros, without the usual European checks, with limited transparency and effectively no accountability. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.

Given that aerial firefighting is excluded from the EASA regulatory framework, does the Commission intend to propose minimum standards for crew fatigue, coordination, separation between aircraft and collision avoidance, as well as to ensure independent investigations?

Will the Commission check whether the employment of NSPA procurement procedures fulfils the prerequisites under Article 9 of Directive 2014/24/EU and will it ask for annual cost analyses for 2019, technical specifications and a rent vs buy comparison analysis?
What are the timeline, disbursements and delivery date of the first two H215?
